⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Speaker arrangement for the channels in an audio stream.

Layouts follow `WebAudio` / `WebCodecs` conventions; unsupported or exotic
arrangements should log [`components.AudioChannelLayout#Unspecified`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_channel_layout?speculative-link) and
are treated as raw interleaved channels by the viewer.

## Variants
#### `Mono` = 0x1
Single channel.

#### `Stereo` = 0x2
L, R.

#### `Lcr` = 0x3
L, R, C.

#### `Quad` = 0x4
L, R, LS, RS.

#### `FiveDot` = 0x5
L, R, C, LS, RS (no LFE).

#### `FiveDotOne` = 0x6
L, R, C, LFE, LS, RS.

#### `SevenDotOne` = 0x8
L, R, C, LFE, LS, RS, SL, SR.

#### `Ambisonic1stOrder` = 0xA
First-order ambisonics (W, Y, Z, X). 4 channels.


## Arrow datatype
```
UInt32
```
